comment: Every runtime package that ships with a PdfNetStack package must be listed here with its verified license. Adding an entry is a license review: check the nuspec license expression, not the project page.

packages.Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime: MIT (LICENSE in the package; native binaries carry ThirdPartyNotices.txt, all permissive). PdfNetStack.Ocr, and bundled with its LICENSE and ThirdPartyNotices.txt in PdfNetStack.Ocr.Tool.
packages.Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime.Managed: MIT (LICENSE.txt in the package). PdfNetStack.Ocr and PdfNetStack.Ocr.Tool.
packages.Microsoft.NETCore.Platforms: Microsoft .NET Library license; contains only runtime.json platform metadata, no code. Implicit dependency of NETStandard.Library 2.0.3.

bundledFiles.ch_PP-OCRv5_det_mobile.onnx: Apache-2.0. PaddleOCR (Copyright (c) 2016 PaddlePaddle Authors), ONNX conversion by RapidOCR (Copyright (c) 2021 RapidAI). PdfNetStack.Ocr.Models and PdfNetStack.Ocr.Tool only, each with LICENSE.txt and NOTICE.txt.
